name: references_by_id
note: stock.reference name lookup (addons/stock/models/stock_reference.py): every reference with its name, by id; read-only replay over the whole population
source_sql: SELECT id, name FROM stock_reference ORDER BY id

name: documents_per_reference
note: stock.reference move/sale/purchase many2many links (stock_reference_move_rel, stock_reference_sale_rel, stock_reference_purchase_rel, addons/stock/models/stock_reference.py), embedded as moveRel/saleRel/purchaseRel: linked documents per reference
source_sql: SELECT r.id, (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_reference_move_rel m WHERE m.reference_id = r.id) AS moves, (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_reference_sale_rel s WHERE s.reference_id = r.id) AS sales, (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_reference_purchase_rel p WHERE p.reference_id = r.id) AS purchases FROM stock_reference r ORDER BY r.id
